    Third-Party Notices

    This project is licensed under GPL-3.0-only. Third-party packages, installations, generated files, and optional tools retain their own licenses. This file is a practical notice summary, not a replacement for the licenses of those projects.

    Runtime Requirements

    • DAETools: GPLv3. Source installations obtain it separately from the DAETools project or a package source you are licensed to use. The Windows desktop distribution bundles its required runtime and notices.
    • PyQt6 and PyQt6-WebEngine: GPL-3.0-only unless used under Riverbank's commercial license.
    • OpenCS: LGPLv3. Install or obtain separately when needed by the DAETools workflow.
    • NumPy: BSD-3-Clause and other permissive notices in the NumPy distribution.
    • xarray: Apache-2.0.
    • pandas: BSD-3-Clause and bundled permissive third-party notices. It is an xarray dependency and supports conversion of labelled results to tables.
    • SciPy: BSD-3-Clause and bundled permissive third-party notices.
    • matplotlib: matplotlib license and bundled third-party notices.
    • openpyxl and its et_xmlfile dependency: MIT. The desktop uses them to write Excel workbooks.
    • Maratype by Artyom Galinov: bundled desktop display font, freely redistributable with no commercial restrictions.
    • pydantic: MIT.
    • PyYAML: MIT.

    Optional Compiled Solver

    Compiled execution is included in the Windows desktop distribution. Source installations use the compiled extra for Python dependencies; a staged native bundle can supply the compiler and solver libraries.

    • filelock 3.20.0: Unlicense. Used to coordinate access to compilation caches.
    • scikit-sundae supplies the SUNDIALS runtime for source Compiled execution without a managed bundle. Its wheel and bundled libraries retain their own notices. Managed desktop builds include a separate native runtime with its own dependency notices under compiled/licenses/.
    • The native Newton helper adapts SUNDIALS control flow under BSD-3-Clause. The bundled license (online) and notice (online) accompany the source and are included in package distributions.
    • The optional vector exponential uses code extracted from SLEEF 3.9.0, copyright Naoki Shibata and contributors, under the Boost Software License 1.0 (online).

    Optional Tools

    • Graphviz is invoked as a separate executable; no pygraphviz binding is used. Its applicable licence and all bundled native-library/font notices travel with the staged distribution. tools/bundle_graphviz.py retains these notices and records versions, source metadata and file hashes in graphviz/bundle.json. See Graphviz bundling (online) for Windows staging and the release layout and checks (online).
    • VTK: BSD-3-Clause.
